sentiment.summary: No congressional signal with mixed small trades by junior member; broad market fear (43 Fear/Greed score) presents potential contrarian opportunity but lack of news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (238.7) indicates extreme market stress, NFP event in 2 days adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 64 days present binary event risk for financials sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical setup with RSI extreme overbought, stochastic bullish cross, and new donchian highs provides multiple momentum confirmations for swing entry near support at 70.23.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 238.7, NFP volatility in 2 days), zero fundamental support (no insider/institutional conviction, earnings binary in 64 days), and weak ADX trend strength (19.88) make this a high-risk fade into overbought technicals rather than a sustainable swing trade.
